description: 固定组合对象本体 — 两层设计: primary_path (树形,互斥) + cross_tags (扁平,可多选)。基于 Kreher & Stinson COMBO 库 15 类 + 组合树.md 扩展。
source: COMBO (Kreher & Stinson, Combinatorial Algorithms, CRC Press 1998) + 用户自定义扩展

Integer Partitions (整数分拆).definition: integer partitions of n: λ = (λ₁ ≥ λ₂ ≥ ... ≥ λₖ > 0), Σλᵢ = n

Plane Partitions (平面分拆).definition: 2-dimensional arrays of nonnegative integers, weakly decreasing along rows and columns, with entries summing to n (the 2D analogue of integer partitions)

Set Partitions (集合划分).definition: partitions of an n-element set into nonempty blocks

Non-crossing Set Partitions.definition: set partitions with no crossing blocks when drawn on a circle

Non-nesting Set Partitions.definition: set partitions with no nesting blocks

Others.definition: set partition variants not yet classified

Restricted Growth Functions (RGF).definition: sequences a₁...aₙ with a₁=0, aᵢ ≤ 1+max(a₁,...,aᵢ₋₁). Bijective to set partitions (Bell numbers). Source: COMBO RGF.

Compositions (组合/有序划分).definition: ordered tuples of positive integers summing to n

Alternating Permutations.definition: σ₁ < σ₂ > σ₃ < σ₄ > ... (up-down) or reverse

Involutions (对合).definition: permutations σ such that σ² = id

Permutations in Cycle Form.definition: permutations expressed as products of disjoint cycles. Source: COMBO CYCLE.

Words & Sequences (字与序列).definition: finite sequences over an alphabet (often [n] or {0,1})

Parking Functions (停车函数).definition: sequences (a₁,...,aₙ) such that |{i: aᵢ ≤ k}| ≥ k for all k

Necklaces & Bracelets (项链与手镯).definition: equivalence classes of words under cyclic rotation / reflection

Lattice Paths (格路).definition: walks in Z² with restricted step sets

Dyck Paths (戴克路).definition: paths from (0,0) to (2n,0) with steps (1,1) and (1,-1), never below x-axis. Source: COMBO BAL.

Motzkin Paths (莫茨金路).definition: paths with steps (1,1), (1,-1), and (1,0), never below x-axis

Schröder Paths (施罗德路).definition: paths with steps (1,1), (1,-1), and (2,0), never below x-axis

Others.definition: lattice path variants not yet classified

Rooted Trees (有根树).definition: trees with a distinguished root vertex

Plane Trees (平面树).definition: rooted trees with ordered children (embedded in the plane)

Binary Trees (二叉树).definition: rooted trees where each node has a left and/or right child

Spanning Trees (生成树).definition: subtrees of a graph that include all vertices

Prüfer Codes (普吕弗编码).definition: sequences of length n-2 over [n], bijective to labeled trees on n vertices. Source: COMBO PRUEFER.

Others.definition: Prüfer code variants not yet classified

Young Tableaux (杨表).definition: fillings of Young diagrams with integer entries

Standard Young Tableaux (标准杨表).definition: SYT: bijective filling of a partition diagram with {1,...,n}, increasing in rows and columns

Semistandard Young Tableaux (半标准杨表).definition: SSYT: weakly increasing rows, strictly increasing columns

Skew Tableaux (斜杨表).definition: fillings of a skew shape λ/μ

Rook Placements (车放置).definition: placements of non-attacking rooks on a board; rook numbers, hit numbers, and the rook polynomial. Source: Kaplansky-Riordan rook theory.

Others.definition: rook placement variants not yet classified

Matchings (匹配).definition: sets of disjoint edges in a graph

Non-crossing Matchings (非交叉匹配).definition: matchings on [2n] with no crossing arcs when drawn on a line

Hyperplane Arrangements (超平面配置).definition: finite collections of hyperplanes in a vector space; chambers, regions, intersection posets, and characteristic polynomials

Shi Arrangements.definition: deformations of the braid arrangement defined by x_i - x_j ∈ {0,1}; regions bijective to parking functions

Braid Arrangements.definition: hyperplanes x_i = x_j for all i<j; regions correspond to permutations, intersection lattice to set partitions

Coxeter Arrangements.definition: reflecting hyperplanes of a finite Coxeter group; regions bijective to group elements

Others.definition: arrangement variants not yet classified (Catalan, Shi-Catalan, Linial, semiorder, etc.)

Tilings & Polyominoes (镶嵌与多格骨牌).definition: tilings of regions by geometric tiles

Lozenge Tilings.definition: tilings of a hexagon by unit rhombi (lozenges)

Graph Colorings (图着色).definition: proper colorings of the vertices or edges of a graph

Eulerian Tours (欧拉回路).definition: cycles traversing every edge of a graph exactly once

Alternating Sign Matrices (交错符号矩阵).definition: square matrices with entries 0,±1, row/col sums = 1, alternating signs

Posets & Lattices (偏序集与格).definition: partially ordered sets and their combinatorial invariants

Linear Extensions.definition: topological sorts / total orders extending a poset

Matroids (拟阵).definition: abstraction of linear independence in vector spaces

Combinatorial Designs (组合设计).definition: balanced arrangements of elements into blocks

Latin Squares (拉丁方).definition: n×n arrays with each symbol appearing once per row and column

Subsets (子集).definition: subsets of [n]; k-subsets of [n]. Source: COMBO SUBSET / KSUBSET.

Special Functions & q-Series (特殊函数与q-级数).definition: hypergeometric series, basic hypergeometric (q-series), elliptic functions, and theta functions appearing in combinatorial generating functions and partition identities

cross_tags._comment: 以下标签可自由组合，挂到任意 primary_path 对象上。每个标签附带简短定义。
cross_tags.overpartition: first occurrence of each part may be overlined / distinguished
cross_tags.distinct parts: all parts are distinct (strict: λ₁ > λ₂ > ... > λₖ)
cross_tags.colored: parts / elements carry colors from a palette of k colors
cross_tags.restricted: parts satisfy additional congruence or gap conditions (e.g., Rogers-Ramanujan type)
cross_tags.plane: 2-dimensional array of integers, non-increasing along rows and columns
cross_tags.non-crossing: no two blocks / arcs / edges cross in the canonical drawing
cross_tags.non-nesting: no two blocks / arcs are nested in the canonical drawing
cross_tags.pattern-avoiding: the object avoids a specified pattern (permutation pattern, word pattern, etc.)
cross_tags.signed: elements carry a ± sign (type B / hyperoctahedral group)
cross_tags.labeled: vertices / elements carry distinct labels from [n]
cross_tags.cyclic: arranged on a circle / modulo cyclic rotation
cross_tags.weight-preserving: the bijection preserves a weight statistic (sum, length, major index, inv, etc.)
cross_tags.involution: the map is an involution: φ² = id (often sign-reversing for combinatorial cancellation)
cross_tags.q-analog: enumeration refined by a statistic, expressed in q-series notation
cross_tags.q-series: proof uses q-series identities (Rogers-Ramanujan type, Heine transformations, etc.)
cross_tags.hypergeometric: proof involves hypergeometric series or identities
cross_tags.bijection to tableau: the domain or codomain involves Young tableaux
cross_tags.bijection to lattice path: the domain or codomain involves lattice paths
cross_tags.bijection to tree: the domain or codomain involves trees
cross_tags.bijection via encoding: the bijection uses an intermediate encoding (e.g., Prüfer code, RGF, inversion sequence)
